Bio

The short version

Vivien — known on stage as Viivn — is a Belgian-born, Melbourne-based DJ and producer whose sound spans melodic techno, progressive, electro and minimal. Shaped by his Belgo-Congolese heritage, international travel and a decade-plus behind the decks, his sets balance energy, precision and emotional depth.

Viivn

Biography

The full story

Vivien is a Belgian-born, Melbourne-based electronic music artist known for his immersive, groove-driven sets and refined sonic identity.

With roots in vinyl and a deep connection to rhythm, his sound draws on a rich tapestry of influences — shaped by his Belgo-Congolese heritage, international travels, and a decade-plus behind the decks. Since beginning his journey in 2010, Vivien has developed a distinctive style that spans melodic techno, progressive, electro and minimal.

After relocating to Melbourne in 2016, he quickly embedded himself in the city's vibrant underground scene, earning a reputation for sets that balance energy, precision and emotional depth. His influences include artists like Pig&Dan, Richie Hawtin, Dubfire and Sven Väth — figures whose forward-thinking approach mirrors Vivien's own evolution.

In 2018, Vivien won the Your Shot DJ competition in Melbourne, leading to a standout debut on the City Steps stage at CRSSD Festival in San Diego — a slot he was invited to reprise in 2019. His international experience also includes sets at Spin and Bang Bang (San Diego, USA) and Le Clan (Prague, Czech Republic), alongside regular appearances at iconic Australian venues including Revolver Upstairs, Brown Alley, New Guernica and Festival No.23.

During the global pause brought by COVID, Vivien focused on redefining his craft — developing a hybrid DJ/live setup that reflects his evolving artistry and technical depth, laying the groundwork for a new chapter in his creative journey.

Recognition

  • Winner — Your Shot Melbourne DJ Competition (2018)
  • DJ Trainer — Your Shot Program (since 2022)

Tech Rider

Live or DJ set

Core requirements below — full written rider available on request.

DJ Set

  • Mixer — Allen & Heath Xone:96 or Pioneer V10
  • 4× Pioneer CDJ-3000 / CDJ-XX (or 3× CDJ-2000NXS2 if unavailable)
  • CDJs updated to latest firmware
  • Record Out on mixer for personal recording

Live Set

  • 80 × 60cm table space beside the main DJ mixer
  • 1× power outlet
  • Line out via XLR or 1/4″ jack / RCA into the main system
Hospitality: stage manager and sound engineer on show day, secured DJ booth. Sparkling or coconut water, cold-pressed green juice, ginger beer — no plastic, please.

Full I/O, stage plot and hospitality rider — request the complete document.
